audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagree with packet.levelChart, and two of them contradict their own whys outright. Page: Lillia/Skill/Maokai/Maokai/Lillia/Maokai/Maokai. Packet: Skill/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Maokai/Skill/Maokai. Worst offenders: row 4 is given to Lillia while whys[4] opens "Maokai owns 6", and rows 2-3 are given to Maokai while whys[2] says you are uncatchable and whys[3] calls 4-5 "your peak".
audit.why: The level 6 row is a safety instruction — the page currently tells the player 6 is her spike on a row whose own text says his root-dash pins her and her sleep cannot save her.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 set to Skill/Lillia/Lillia/Lillia/Maokai/Skill in both layers, matching the packet and each row's why. Ratings re-scaled to 5/6/6/7/3/5. phases[0].why and phases[4].why rewritten so the full layer stops contradicting the same rows.
sources: brief spikes[1].text ("His Level 6 is the scary one")

audit.whatIsWrong: Twisted Advance is the tracked cooldown on every screen of this page and is never numbered — 14/13/12/11/10s at 525 range. Bramble Smash's 7s and Nature's Grasp's 130s are absent too, and packet.sequencingCues counts only one cue on the whole matchup.
audit.why: "Commit on Twisted Advance's cooldown" is the page's entire green-light system and the reader is given nothing to count.
audit.corrected: 14s at rank 1 and 525 range written into dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three things. (a) tldr and report[0].t claim "he has no way to stop the jog" — Bramble Smash grounds, knocks back and slows, and Twisted Advance is a point-and-click root. (b) whys[2] says "his passive sustain can't out-heal a compounding DoT", but Sap Magic's cooldown is reduced each time Maokai casts a spell OR IS STRUCK BY AN ENEMY SPELL: every Dream Dust application and every Q ring makes his heal come back faster. (c) Twisted Advance makes him untargetable for the duration of the dash, so anything you time onto the engage simply misses.
audit.why: (b) inverts the lane plan — the page tells the player to out-poke a sustain that her poke is accelerating. Anti-heal stops being optional, which is the one thing report[8].t already gets right and the rest of the page argues against.
audit.corrected: tldr and report[0].t now name the grounding Q and the root W. whys[2] now says every spell you land shortens his passive heal and to buy anti-heal. dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns carry the untargetable window and the heal acceleration.
sources: enemyKit P text "Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced"
enemyKit W text "becoming untargetable and dashing to the target"
enemyKit Q flags grounding, knockup, slow

notes: No mirror existed, so this file defines the chart maokai__lillia must match: Skill, Lillia, Lillia, Lillia, Maokai, Skill, Maokai — identical to packet.levelChart. Worth flagging beyond the edits: the Sap Magic acceleration undercuts the sustain claim in three more strings I did not rewrite (content.early "his passive sustain can't out-heal a stacked DoT", content.mid, wants.you[0] "so his sustain can never out-heal the burn"). They are the same error as whys[2] and are worth a second pass together with it, but the burn does still out-pace him with Grievous Wounds up, so they are overstated rather than flatly false and I fixed the one that states it most baldly. report[8].t already says to add anti-heal early, which is now consistent with the rest of the page rather than contradicted by it.
